messages:
tom-liu: Heads up — during a pricing experiment we invoiced three annual Dedicated plans as revenue instead of setting up deferrals. Can we get an on-the-books fix before close?
sara: can you drop invoice numbers and amounts? I'll pull GL postings.
tom-liu: invoices: INV-2026-0312 ($72,000), INV-2026-0402 ($54,000), INV-2026-0410 ($54,000). Billed dates: 2026-01-30, 2026-02-02, 2026-02-10. Service period starts 2026-02-01 for all.
mike_fin: thanks. Preliminary GL lookup: all three hit Rev - Subscription (4000) on 2026-02-01. Need reclass to Deferred Rev (2100). Also two had "commit_promo" discount lines.
billing-bot: note: commit_promo was applied as invoice discount (net price) for INV-2026-0312 and INV-2026-0410 per billing ledger.
sara: OK so deferred amount should be net of discounts. Does anyone have the discount amounts?
tom-liu: INV-2026-0312 discount $6,000, INV-2026-0410 discount $4,000. INV-2026-0402 had no discount.
mike_fin: math check: net deferred totals = 72k-6k + 54k + 54k-4k = 170k. Monthly amort over 12 months starting 2026-02 -> 14,166.67/month.
audit_team_bot: reminder: include a short memo for auditors describing the experiment, cause of mispost, and corrective entries.
sara: Proposed journal today: Journal JE-2026-04-550
```
Dr Rev - Subscription (4000)      170,000
  Cr Deferred Rev (2100)         170,000
Memo: Reclass prepaid annual Dedicated contracts invoiced during pricing experiment to deferred revenue; amortize monthly starting 2026-02-01.
```
mike_fin: I'll prepare JE and upload supporting schedule. Also propose an accrual for usage true-ups: estimate 2% of committed usage will convert to overage in first month -> accrual liability 3,400 to capture expected billings vs prepaids.
tom-liu: agree conservative accrual is fine. Put as Accrued Revenue (liability) pending actuals.
billing-bot: automated-check: INV-2026-0312 had tax rounding variance posted to 2105 (Sales Tax) — confirm tax treatment with tax team before JE post.
sara: noted. Action items: 1) Mike to post JE and include schedule + link to invoice EDI. 2) Tom to draft one-paragraph auditor memo and attach. 3) Billing to confirm tax rounding by EOD.
mike_fin: JE posted JE-2026-04-550 in NetSuite. Attached deferral schedule and per-invoice calculations.
tom-liu: Drafted auditor note: "Pricing experiment (Jan 28	6 Feb 11) temporarily changed billing automation. Three annual prepayments were recorded to revenue in error and have been reclassified to deferred revenue before month-end close. See JE-2026-04-550 and attached amortization schedule." I'll put in close binder.
sara: Closing adjustment confirmed. I'll sign off on close checklist after tax confirm. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: tax-confirm: Sales Tax team confirmed variance is immaterial; no additional tax JE required.
audit_team_bot: ack: memo and supporting workpapers received. No further auditor questions at this time.
mike_fin: Closing notes: we'll add a short billing-rule test to staging that prevents annual prepay invoices from auto-posting to revenue. Filing a ticket with Billing eng.
tom-liu: filing ticket now — BLG-9876. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
